title: Billet Designator-Political Military Officer (I) (Gen to 2ndLt) FMOS, DC PP&O
raw_text:
1. MOS 8220, Billet Designator-Political Military Officer (I) (Gen to 2ndLt)
FMOS, DC PP&O

    a. Summary. The Political-Military Officer MOS is used to designate
those billets requiring advanced knowledge and experience in international
affairs. Officers assigned to fill these billets may include but are not
limited to Regional Affairs Officers (RAO) and Foreign Area Officers (FAO).
It will also be used to identify officers undergoing training as RAOs until
they complete the requirements for designation in a regional sub-specialty
(FMOS 8221-8228), officers participating in foreign professional military
education (FPME) or personnel exchange program (PEP) participants in English-
speaking countries. Additionally, officers who serve in non-regionally
affiliated political military (pol-mil) affairs billets which do not require
the ability to speak a secondary language qualify for this FMOS (i.e.
legislative affairs, Department of State, liaison officers, political/
military fellowships, or other interagency department requiring pol-mil
expertise). This MOS may be assigned only as a FMOS. MOS 8220 will be
assigned and voided only by authority of CMC (MM).

    b. Prerequisites. Must have been selected to the international affairs
program through the commandant’s professional intermediate-level board and
started the national security affairs graduate degree program.

       c.    Requirements.     This MOS is to be used as a billet designator in T/Os.

       d.    Duties.   None.

    e. Related Standard Occupational Classification (SOC) Title and Code.
Political Scientists 19-3094.

       f.    Related Military Skill.     None.

No military crosswalk codes enter the task ranking. All positive top-20 results retained; zero-similarity destinations are not recommendations.
